sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage_marvel_heroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180
